callout.text: Morning refresh 11 Nov ~6:30 AM HKT: Into the Wild still LIVE (Mon 9 Nov 10:00 AM – Fri 13 Nov 8:00 PM local). 5★ Crowned Sword Zacian + Crowned Shield Zamazenta (catch Hero of Many Battles — hundo 2188 / 2735 Cloudy) and 3★ Druddigon + Orthworm. No 1★ or Mega published for this event (official + Leek Duck). Remote Raid limit 30. Zacian Raid Hour (Mon 9, 6–7 PM) ENDED worldwide. Zamazenta Raid Hour (Tue 10, 6–7 PM local) ended in Asia, Oceania, and Europe; still later today in the Americas (starting shortly in Eastern North America as of this check). Today’s 5★ Max Battle is Dynamax Registeel (Max dens, not gym raid cards; Regidrago Thu / Latias+Latios Fri). Shadow 1★ Larvitar/Mudkip/Makuhita/Cranidos + Shadow 3★ Prinplup/Piloswine/Poliwhirl still listed (Leek Duck + GO Hub). Shadow Tornadus first weekend ended; longer package resumes Mon 16 Nov → Tue 1 Dec. Upcoming unchanged: GO Wild Area Global Sat 14 (Zekrom + White Kyurem + Dynamax Dialga) & Sun 15 (Reshiram + Black Kyurem + Dynamax Palkia) + Modern Jacket Machamp 3★ → Cresselia + Darkrai 5★ + Mega Banette Mon 16–Tue 24 Nov → Deoxys (all 4 formes) 5★ + Mega Metagross Wed 25 Nov–Tue 1 Dec. Eggs (Leek Duck Updated Sep 14; Wild Area 10 km event pool Honedge/Klefki/Drampa/Duraludon starts Sat 14) / Rocket (Updated Oct 2; Giovanni inactive) unchanged.
callout.endsAtLabel: Into the Wild → Fri 13 Nov 8:00 PM local · Zamazenta Raid Hour (Tue 10) later today in the Americas 6–7 PM local · Dynamax Registeel Max Battles today
